headline: Mariupol lands go to Russian developers: occupiers are not restoring housing for residents
summary: In Mariupol, Russian occupation authorities are transferring land plots to developers from Russia rather than restoring housing for residents, according to the report.
why: Land allocation and property development in occupied areas bear on reconstruction costs and the economic value of Ukrainian real estate.
